device_entry.name: TC038D烘箱温控器
tags: 环境控制与稳定性测试
过程控制与工业仪表实验
device_entry.description: 用于控制HCP TC038D烘箱的温度控制器，可通过Modbus原始字节通信读取寄存器、写入参数、设置温度设定值并监测当前温度，适用于实验中的加热与恒温控制。
device_entry.description_en: A temperature controller for the HCP TC038D oven. It communicates via Modbus raw bytes to read registers, write parameters, set the temperature setpoint, and monitor the current temperature for laboratory heating and temperature regulation.

schema.description_en: Write multiple register values to the specified address.
